author: Ravi Selkirk, walkaround audit
notes: Three days booked at Kestrel this week off Delia's plan. Day one handed back at the gate and still charged.
Monday was written for the 2022-H2 build on its own and the charge hand would not run it. He also said there is next to nothing of that build left on his yard.
Tuesday and Wednesday ran. Twenty-five vans each, twenty-five faults booked on the Tuesday and twenty-eight on the Wednesday, all on the WA-52 pads.
Register says the last L-14 van went back on 24 February. Nothing on the log for an L-14 van past its fourteenth month; checked the four oldest and they all stop.
Fifteen days left of the eighteen.
